differences: auth.users has only synthetic id primary key; auth.uid reads a local session GUC and does not verify JWT.
extensions.uuid_generate_v4 is a local SQL shim to pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid; original extension runtime omitted.
Objects owned by a private nonlogin non-superuser fixture_owner instead of production postgres.
RLS enabled and not forced as captured; production policies omitted and caller table grants revoked. This is stricter than production and does not validate its direct-table authorization.
Only seven relevant public tables and three captured trigger bindings; other public/auth/storage objects and external workers omitted.
Four independent caller login roles, no inheritance or bypass. Actual Supabase/PostgREST role inheritance, claims verification and service bypass not reproduced.
No rules/extension hooks/remote data; native upstream PostgreSQL 17.4 is not complete Supabase.

differences: Synthetic auth.users and request GUC identity; no Auth/JWT/PostgREST validation.
storage.buckettype is a local enum containing only observed STANDARD; complete enum labels were not captured.
Seven Storage trigger bindings are deliberately omitted because reviewed function bodies were not captured; no guessed behavior.
storage.foldername is the disclosed old RLS local SQL shim; Storage HTTP and service role inheritance are not reproduced.
Storage object ordinal 13 is preserved by creating then dropping an inert text placeholder.
Owners are local fixture_owner, not production postgres or supabase_storage_admin.
Synthetic project/story deleted_at and all t02 asset, verification, observation and binding tables are test-only.
Historical ledger source-project mutation races run before the RLS immutable-story trigger is installed. All final integration checks run with that trigger and candidate RLS active.
